prompt: When do delegations need to start registering for the NMUN conference held in New York from April 6-10 or April 13-17, 2025, and what are the key steps related to applying for a visa?
expected_answer: Registration for the NMUN conference starts on 1 September 2024. To apply for a visa, a delegation should register and pay the fee before requesting a visa invitation letter, which can be requested after 1 August 2024.
final_answer: Delegations need to start registering for the NMUN conference held in New York from April 6-10 or April 13-17, 2025, and they should contact the Embassy or Consulate of New Zealand well in advance to apply for a visa. Failure to secure visas before the payment deadline will result in the delegation being withdrawn from the conference. A visa does not guarantee entry, so everyone should have a copy of the letter, travel itinerary, and return plane ticket. To request a letter, the school must register for the conference, pay the registration fee, confirm delegate numbers online, and schedule a visa appointment. Only one letter per school will be issued listing all applicants, and it can be copied for each person's visa application.
